THE AGI EDGE — KIMI SPACE RACE STARTER KIT

1. Open space-explorer.html in a modern desktop browser.
2. Try planet selection, pause/resume, orbit speed, and reset.
3. Open prompts.txt and copy the Space Explorer prompt.
4. Open Kimi using the link below and paste the prompt.
5. To remix this demo, attach space-explorer.html or paste its source.
6. Save the complete HTML Kimi returns as index.html; open it in a browser.
7. Check every control. If anything breaks, send the error to Kimi and ask
   for the full corrected file.

Mobile: use the live demo on the guide page. A desktop is easiest for files.

Kimi campaign link (includes intentionally empty UTM values):
http://kimi.ai?utm_campaign=TR_YqObYt0Y&utm_content=&utm_medium=Instagram&utm_source=CH_pzQ7f4g6&utm_term=

The kit is free. Kimi features and limits depend on your account.
The demo was made for this guide, not generated live by Kimi.
Fictional worlds. Illustration only; not to scale.
